name: Monotonic co-VC Dimension / Monotonic Projected Minimum Teaching Set Size
details: A minimum teaching set becomes a hollow star after its target is removed; the two monotonic envelopes preserve this comparison.
proof: Let $\mathcal F$ be any coordinate projection of a subfamily of $\mathcal H$, and choose $h\in\mathcal F$ with a smallest teaching set $S$ of size $d=\mathrm{TS}_{\min}(\mathcal F)$. Minimality of $S$ gives, for every $x\in S$, a concept $h_x\in\mathcal F$ agreeing with $h$ on $S\setminus\{x\}$ and differing at $x$. In the projection of $\mathcal F\setminus\{h\}$ to $S$, the trace of $h$ is absent and all its one-coordinate flips are present. Hence $\mathrm{coVC}(\mathcal F\setminus\{h\})\ge d$. Since $\mathrm{coVC}^*$ is monotonic under both subfamilies and projections, $\mathrm{coVC}^*(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm{TS}_{\min}(\mathcal F)$. Maximizing over $\mathcal F$ proves $\mathrm{coVC}^*(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm{TS}_{\min}^{*p}(\mathcal H)$.
